name: DJ TechTools Midi Fighter Twister (6 side buttons as CC)
description: Same as the Twister profile, for a device whose two middle side buttons are set to CC Hold in Midi Fighter Utility instead of Previous/Next Bank. All six side buttons then send ch4 CCs, six per bank (bank n, 0-based: 8+6n..13+6n, in the order left-top, left-middle, left-bottom, right-top, right-middle, right-bottom). Right-middle steps to the next bank (shift + right-middle: previous); the app shows the bank's page and sends the bank change to the device. Left-middle toggles Chain Link on the FX chain of the row you touched last. Left-top, right-top and right-bottom are the navigation buttons and left-bottom is Shift, as in the Twister profile. Utility: middle side buttons = CC Hold, side corners = CC Hold, encoders relative (ENC 3FH/41H), switches CC Hold. To use it, copy it to your profiles in Preferences > MIDI (a user profile with a matching device wins over the built-in Twister profile).
